sn17.24:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Dāruṇo bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe|| || Saddhā bhikkhave upāsikā ekam dhītaraṃ piyaṃ manāpam evaṃ sammā āyācamānā āyāceyya || || Tādisā āyye bhavāhi yādisā Khujjuttarā ca upāsikā Veḷukaṇḍakiyā ca Nandamātāti || || Esā bhikkhave tulā etam pamāṇaṃ mama sāvikānam upāsikānam yadidam Khujjuttarā ca upāsikā Veḷukaṇḍakiyā ca Nandamātā || || Sa ce kho tvam ayye agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajasi || tādisā āyye bhavāhi yādisā Khemā ca bhikkhunī Uppalavaṇṇā cāti || || Esā bhikkhave tulā etam pamāṇaṃ mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ yadidaṃ Khemā ca bhikkhunī Uppalavaṇṇā ca || Mā ca kho tvam ayye sekham appamattamānasam lābhasakkārasiloko anupāpuṇātūti || || Taṃ ce bhikkhave bhikkhuniṃ sekham appattamānasaṃ lābhasakkārasiloko anupāpuṇāti || so tassā hoti antarāyāya || Evaṃ dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe || || Evañhi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbanti || || Catutthaṃ
